description: Fix a Gradle-based Java, Kotlin or Spring Boot project that fails to compile, test or package.
requirements: Repository should contain a Gradle project with build.gradle, build.gradle.kts or settings.gradle files
Repository should include a clear build fix commit or pull request
Gradle build command such as ./gradlew build, gradlew.bat build or gradle build should complete successfully
Fix should address the real cause such as dependency conflicts, plugin version issues, missing repositories, compile errors or failing tests
Existing application behavior should remain compatible after the build fix
README.md, issue note or commit message should explain the build failure and the fix
title: Fix Gradle Project Build Failure
